works.body:
Hello! Your art is so wonderful. Would you please draw my original character?

🪽 FAUST | "35" YEARS OLD | 178 CM
› She is a "cab driver" who can only be requested by appointment. 
› In truth, her clients are not ordinary people in need of a taxi. Rather, they are hopeless people who have been driven into a corner. They have nowhere else to go, so they turn to her as a last resort. She is a cab driver on the outside, but is actually a talented assassin under wraps. She only helps those who she deems to be "victims," and her clientele largely includes those escaping from violent situations, or those who are looking to get revenge on people who are powerful and otherwise difficult to touch.
› Raised in the church as an orphan, despite her unconventional profession, she is a deeply religious person with her own personal sense of right and wrong. Though her methods can be cruel and twisted, to her, so long as she is protecting a "lamb" from a "wolf," she would gladly become the slaughterer.
› Hedonistic, confident, and charismatic. She lives unabashedly for herself. Her life is meaningless to her in the grand scheme of thing, and despite her faith, she does not believe in heaven or hell. So, she would like to spend her meager human life doing all that she can for the world before she departs.
› Known in the underground community as "the Reaper" and the "Angel of Death."

APPEARANCE: 
› She typically wears around blue sunglasses, and has her hair up in a ponytail. Her jewelry is silver. She likes to wear dark colors, like black and burgundy. Her style is very "femme fatale."
› Her hair is white, and her bangs have light blue ends that match her eyes. When down, her hair is straight and goes all the way to her knees.
› Her eyes are a very pale blue. They have white crosses as pupils.
› She has four beauty marks that form a line down her right eye.
› She has scarring on her face that goes across her face and down and through her left eye. 
› She also has scars all over her torso. 
› She has white angel wing tattoos that cover her shoulders. They look like wings folding over her. 

QUIRKS:
› She loves sweets and alcohol. 
› She has a soft spot for baby animals and people who remind her of baby animals.
› Despite looking very cool and tough, she cries a lot over sad movies.
› A bit of a slob. 

Faust is a modern-day "Robin Hood" with a darker twist. She does not mind getting her hands dirtied if it means freedom for someone else who has been oppressed. Her weapons of choice are a Rhino 60DS Nebula pistol, as well as a small hand-knife. 

Composition and pose are entirely up to you. Please feel free to turn down this request for any reason whatsoever. Thank you so much for your time and consideration!
